methodological_law.formal: SOURCE_CLASS(F) != POST_REDUCER_TERMINAL_CLASS(REDUCE(F)) is permitted; no equality invariant exists

SOURCE_CLASS.meaning: Independently checked membership of the original canonical CNF in the preregistered intended calibration class

REDUCTION_OUTCOME.meaning: Exact certified transformation under the already-frozen reducer, including existing replay and reconstruction obligations
REDUCTION_OUTCOME.required_scope_definition: Exactly the satisfiability, witness reconstruction, UNSAT preservation, and certificate obligations already frozen by R0; this successor grants no stronger logical-equivalence claim

POST_REDUCER_TERMINAL_CLASS.meaning: Classification of the residual actually produced by the frozen reducer under the already-frozen R0 terminal and reducer-outcome contracts

for_intended_class_C: SOURCE_CLASS_EXPECTATION: original canonical F is independently verified to satisfy F in C
REDUCER_SOUNDNESS: frozen exact certificates/reconstruction obligations verify F -> F_star in the already-required scope
POST_REDUCER_SOUNDNESS: F_star is soundly classified as a member of frozen C_USF_R0 or another already-permitted frozen reducer outcome under the existing R0 contract
generic_examples_not_special_exceptions: A source 2CNF may validly reduce to EMPTY_CNF_SAT
A source 2CNF may validly reduce to EMPTY_CLAUSE_UNSAT
A source Horn, renamable-Horn, or affine calibration formula may validly simplify into a different stronger or easier terminal already frozen in C_USF_R0
No example authorizes a new terminal class, rule, recognizer, or reducer outcome

post_reducer_terminal_contract.question: WHAT_CLASS_DID_THE_REDUCER_LEAVE_US_IN
post_reducer_terminal_contract.soundness_rule: Any claimed terminal membership must be supported by the already-frozen recognizer authority for that residual; otherwise retain the exact already-permitted frozen reducer outcome without inventing a class
post_reducer_terminal_contract.post_reducer_open_or_nonterminal_outcome: Where the existing frozen calibration contract requires a sound terminal and the residual cannot be soundly classified under the existing R0 contract, emit POST_REDUCER_TERMINAL_CALIBRATION_FAILURE; do not expand the catalogue or patch the reducer

distinct_failure_domains.SOURCE_CLASS_CALIBRATION_FAILURE: Original canonical source formula fails independently checked membership in its preregistered intended class
distinct_failure_domains.POST_REDUCER_TERMINAL_CALIBRATION_FAILUR: Residual fails the sound post-reducer classification/outcome requirement already frozen for that calibration context
distinct_failure_domains.REDUCER_REPLAY_FAILURE: Frozen reducer transformation certificate or reconstruction replay fails
distinct_failure_domains.TRUTH_AUTHORITY_FAILURE: Existing frozen witness/proof truth authority fails
distinct_failure_domains.WIDTH_AUTHORITY_FAILURE: Existing frozen width certificate validation/replay fails
distinct_failure_domains.CAUSAL_FIREWALL_FAILURE: Truth or later-stage information influences an earlier frozen causal stage, retention, or seed
